fieldData.meta-description: Build a customer satisfaction survey with CSAT, NPS, and CES questions. Tie every response to the customer and alert on low scores. Free to start.
fieldData.description: Describe what you want to measure. Emergent builds the CSAT, NPS, and CES questions, the follow-ups by score, and a live dashboard, with every response in a database you own.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: CSAT, NPS, CES, or all three. Emergent builds the questions, the branching by score, the alerts, and the database behind them.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
CSAT, NPS, CES, and open text in one survey

Every question type satisfaction research uses: a 1-5 CSAT scale, a 0-10 NPS question, a 1-7 CES scale, and open follow-ups. Add or remove a question by describing it.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Follow-up questions that change by score

Promoters get a review request, passives a feature question, and detractors an open follow-up. CSAT and effort scores branch the same way, set in one line of the prompt.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Alerts on low scores

A Slack alert on every detractor, a HubSpot task on every low CSAT, and an email to the owner for key accounts. Every alert carries the score, the comment, and the customer.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
A live CSAT, NPS, and CES dashboard

Generated with the survey and reading from the response database. Filter by segment, plan, or time window, and share one live view with your team instead of a monthly report.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-6-content:
Responses in a database you own

Every response lands in a table in your project, with no response cap. The survey, the dashboard, and every historical response export to your GitHub whenever you want.
fieldData.acrm---why-emergent-description: A survey only pays off when a low score reaches someone who can act. Emergent ties every response to the customer and alerts the owner.

fieldData.acrm---usecase-heading: Satisfaction Surveys You Can Build in Minutes
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
A SaaS onboarding survey where retention is decided

A three-touch customer satisfaction survey on day 7, day 30, and day 90, with CSAT and effort questions, an open follow-up, and a role field. Every response is tied to the account, plan, and customer success manager, and low scores alert the CSM in Slack.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
A post-purchase survey that turns deliveries into reviews

Sent a week after delivery, with a product rating, a delivery question, and a fit question. Every response is tied to the order and SKU, low ratings flag the returns team, and five-star customers get a review request.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
A quarterly B2B customer satisfaction survey per account

CSAT, NPS, and CES per product line with an open comment per section. Every response is tied to the account and account executive, and a per-account summary lands in HubSpot before the quarterly business review.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
A CSAT and effort survey on every closed ticket

Fired when a support ticket closes, with a satisfaction or effort scale and a follow-up on low scores. Every response is tied to the ticket, agent, and resolution time, feeding a live per-agent dashboard for the support lead.

fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Pick the metric, tie every answer to the customer, and route low scores to someone who can act. Emergent generates the survey, the follow-ups, the alerts, and the dashboard from one description, with no response cap.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-1-des: Use CSAT right after a transaction, NPS for loyalty over time, and CES for the effort of a single interaction. Pick one headline metric per survey; asking all three at once costs completions before it adds insight.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Send it where the experience just happened: on ticket close, seven days after delivery, at day 30 of onboarding, or at quarter end for B2B accounts. A survey tied to a real moment gets more responses than a long one sent weeks later.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-des: Pair the score with one question about why, one segmentation field such as plan or role, and one improvement question. Branch by score: promoters get a review request, passives a feature question, and detractors an open follow-up.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pass the customer ID, account, plan, order, or ticket ID with the survey link, so every answer is saved with its context. Without it, a low score is an anonymous number. With it, it is an account someone can call today.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build a customer satisfaction survey for my customers.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-5-des: Decide who hears about which score: a Slack alert to the CSM on every detractor, a HubSpot task on a low CSAT, an email to the account owner for key accounts. Every alert should carry the score, the comment, and the customer.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-6-des: Emergent generates the survey, the branching, the alerts, and a live CSAT, NPS, and CES dashboard, all reading from a response database you own. Embed it in your app or emails, or share it on your own domain.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-7-des: Read the dashboard weekly by segment and product area, follow up on every detractor within a day, and tell customers what changed because of their feedback. Adjust the questions and thresholds by prompting as patterns appear.
